_what: CROSS-POST art-uniqueness registry (#802). Maps each launch post's slug -> the sha256 of the background ART PNG bytes that post's cards are composed over. The guard (smoke/art-registry.ts assertArtUnique) throws if a post would ship art whose sha256 is already registered to a DIFFERENT post — enforcing the operator rule: EVERY new post gets its OWN distinct artwork; cards within the SAME post may share art, but a new post must not inherit the previous post's art.
_provenance: post1 = sha256 of out/review/lfah/image/_art-base.png (the original nano-banana art post #1's cards were composed over, #787/#790). post2 = the fresh #803 nano-banana gen (_art-base-post2.png). Hashes are over the raw PNG bytes.
